question: Compare the performance of two brands or products and explain why they differ.
sql:
SELECT p.brand,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.sale_price), 2) AS avg_price,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price)), 3) AS margin,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned'), COUNT(*)), 3) AS return_rate
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
report: Compare on four measures: volume, average price, margin and return rate. A brand can lead on revenue and still be the weaker business if its margin is thin or its return rate is high. After finding the measure that differs most, look at category mix to explain it.
